title: Galbot
summary: Beijing embodied-AI start-up building humanoid robots for retail and logistics tasks.
bodyHtml:
Galbot was founded in 2023 and develops wheeled humanoid robots for shelf stocking, picking and retail assistance. It combines a mobile base with arms and a learned manipulation stack.

The company is part of a dense Chinese ecosystem of humanoid makers competing on cost and fast iteration in real stores and warehouses.

Why it matters

  • Wheeled humanoid for retail shelves
  • Manipulation models trained on store data
  • Cost-focused hardware

businessMeaning: Retail is a demanding test: public-facing robots must be safe, quiet and reliable, and the tasks change by store. Galbot's bet is that Chinese retail density provides the training ground.
investmentLens: Private and China-based; public read is through component suppliers and the retail partners running pilots.
